name: Kitchen Island
instruction: Please create a 3D model of a kitchen island. It should have a rectangular shape with a flat countertop and storage cabinets underneath. Include a couple of drawers and a built-in sink on one side. The island should be designed to be placed in the center of a kitchen.

Shape accuracy: The object in the images is a kitchen island.
The kitchen island has a rectangular shape.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The size of the countertop is proportionate to the base of the island.
The height of the cabinets is proportionate to the overall height of the island.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The island is designed to be placed in the center of the kitchen.
The drawers are accessible from the front of the island.
The built-in sink is positioned on one side for easy access.
Object distance and contact: The cabinets are properly aligned under the countertop.
The drawers do not obstruct the sink or each other.
There is enough space around the island for movement.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified attributes are accurately represented.
The design includes a rectangular shape, flat countertop, storage cabinets, drawers, and a built-in sink.
